data.marketLevelRationale: Fresh graduate with only 6 months of internship experience and foundational web skills. No professional employment history, no demonstrated ability to deliver production code or manage real-world requirements. Personal projects indicate self-motivation but lack evidence of complexity, scale, or business impact. This candidate is at the earliest stage of career development.

salaryRange.note: Based on Da Nang entry-level developer rates (2024). Market for fresh graduates in Vietnam's IT sector is competitive with many similar candidates. Salary reflects zero professional track record. Actual offers will depend on internship performance documentation and portfolio quality.

coreStrengths.evidence: Completed college diploma in IT and built 2 personal projects using HTML/CSS/JavaScript, demonstrating ability to construct functional user-facing code
6-month internship as manual tester indicates hands-on exposure to testing workflows, defect identification, and quality verification processes
Initiative to build personal projects beyond curriculum shows intrinsic motivation and ability to learn independently without direct supervision

criticalGaps.impact: Employer cannot assess ability to meet deadlines, collaborate in teams, handle production pressure, or integrate into existing codebases. All experience is academic/internship-level with lower expectations and mentorship.

criticalGaps.evidence: Profile shows frontend HTML/CSS/JS only. No database, server-side language, APIs, or architecture experience. Severely limits job market options in Da Nang where most roles expect broader stack knowledge.

criticalGaps.gap: Shallow technical depth across all skills
criticalGaps.impact: Basic JavaScript proficiency is insufficient for real-world development. Candidate cannot independently design systems, debug complex issues, optimize performance, or handle edge cases that professionals encounter daily.

criticalGaps.gap: No soft skills or industry context documentation
criticalGaps.impact: Profile provides no evidence of communication ability, problem-solving approach, client interaction, or understanding of business requirements—all critical for progression beyond entry level.

data.uniqueValueProposition: A motivated fresh graduate with practical manual testing exposure and foundational frontend development skills, ready to learn rapidly in a structured junior developer role with mentorship.
data.readinessNote: Score reflects significant barriers to immediate employment. Candidate has met the absolute minimum threshold for entry-level consideration (diploma + internship + basic portfolio), but lacks the professional experience, technical depth, or breadth that even junior roles typically expect. Ready to land an entry-level position only if: (1) internship supervisor provides strong performance reference, (2) personal projects are polished and documented well, (3) candidate has prepared for behavioral questions about teamwork and learning. Without these, will face rejection in competitive Da Nang market. Expected 4-6 month job search timeline.
